description: List canonical company templates, optionally filtered by kind, scope, command use case, or public t-xxxx share code. Templates persist canonical commands but do not execute generations. System templates named `Demo — …` are worked examples of the canonical command language; read one with `get_template` before authoring a first brief or workflow.

TemplateKind.description: generation_preset is writable; batch_workflow is retained read-only history.

inputSchema.description: Input schema for listing company templates.

catalog_scope.description: Filter by library or owner_only. Owner-only templates are hidden unless explicitly requested.

share_code.description: Return the template assigned this public t-xxxx share code

template_kind.description: Filter generation presets or read-only historical batch_workflow records

use_case.description: Filter by a use_case present in any stored command

name: list_templates
title: List Templates
